title: The names of the Moon's features: the IAU's Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, at their centres
provider: U.S. Geological Survey Astrogeology Science Center, for the IAU Working Group for Planetary System Nomenclature
credit: Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, IAU WGPSN and USGS Astrogeology
format: ESRI shapefile of points in a ZIP archive; its dBASE table holds for each feature its name, origin, diameter (km), centre (center_lon 0 to 360 E, center_lat; planetocentric, the Moon 2000 sphere of 1737.4 km in the mean-Earth frame), type, approval and a link to its page. 9087 features when registered (2026-10-28).
coverage: The whole Moon; the gazetteer is revised as names are adopted
citation: Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature. International Astronomical Union (IAU) Working Group for Planetary System Nomenclature (WGPSN). https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/
